solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Inflammatory article stated in reactionary journal

indicators.note: the word for stated sits inside the turned-round word for journal
a reactionary goes backwards, so the word for journal is read in reverse

parts.note: a rag is a disparaging word for a newspaper
spoke means said or stated

explanation.surface: A firebrand piece of writing was published in a right-wing paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reactionary' makes GAR. 'Inflammatory' suggests a rabble-rousing essay; in fact a gas poker is a metal tube fed by gas that is used to light a coal fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A gas poker is a device for kindling fires, so it is literally an object that sets things alight.

clue.text: Ridge seen every second in fair weather

indicators.note: taking every second letter of the words fair and weather picks out the ridge

explanation.surface: A mountain ridge comes into view on a sunny day.
explanation.definitionFit: An arête is a sharp mountain ridge between two glacial valleys.

clue.text: Place of judgment where Penny advanced tycoon

parts.note: early means ahead of time, advanced
Bill Gates is the famous software tycoon

explanation.surface: Somewhere a court sat on a case in which Penny promoted a business magnate.
explanation.definitionFit: Heaven's entrance is traditionally where St Peter judges who may enter.

clue.text: Power of poor American car among equipment

indicators.note: the pieces for poor, American and car go among the letters of the equipment word

parts.note: kit is gear or equipment
low means poor in quality
the Model T was Ford's famous car

explanation.surface: A clapped-out US car is wedged among some gear.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit of a thousand watts measures electrical power.

clue.text: Irresolute aunts playing a dangerous game

indicators.note: playing about with the letters of irresolute and aunts rearranges them

explanation.surface: Dithering aunts take part in a risky pastime.
explanation.definitionFit: Spinning a revolver with one bullet and firing at your head is a lethal gamble.

clue.text: Prestige suffering in court

indicators.note: the word for suffering sits inside the abbreviation for court

parts.note: an ache is pain, suffering

explanation.surface: Someone's standing takes a knock during a trial.
explanation.definitionFit: Cachet means distinction or prestige that confers status.

clue.text: Accessory for many an artist attracts tax

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, i.e. many
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
VAT is value added tax

explanation.surface: Some neckwear favoured by painters gets taxed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'attracts' simply joins the pieces. VAT is the British sales tax.
explanation.definitionFit: A cravat is a neckwear item, an accessory to an outfit.

clue.text: Salad has price cut

indicators.note: cut means the final letter of the price word is lopped off

parts.note: cost is price

explanation.surface: The salad has been reduced in price.
explanation.definitionFit: Cos is a variety of lettuce, so a salad leaf.

clue.text: Free from blame once one is over rebuke

indicators.note: in a down clue, one is placed above, i.e. over, the rebuke word

parts.note: ex means former, once
to rate is to scold or rebuke

explanation.surface: A former person is rid of blame after a telling-off.
explanation.definitionFit: To exonerate is to clear someone of fault or guilt.

clue.text: Respect of French detective

parts.note: de is French for of
a tail is a detective who shadows someone

explanation.surface: A French detective is held in high regard.
explanation.definitionFit: As in 'in every respect', a detail is a particular point or aspect.

clue.text: Picture biscuits straight from the oven

parts.note: ginger snaps are biscuits
freshly baked food is hot

explanation.surface: An image of freshly baked biscuits.
explanation.definitionFit: A snapshot is a quick informal photograph, a picture.

clue.text: Profoundly boring

definitions.meaning: a shaft bored into the ground for water

explanation.definitionFit: The word works as an adverb meaning thoroughly and as a noun for a hole bored to reach water.

clue.text: Dog making miner aware

indicators.note: making implies the letters of miner and aware are made into something new

explanation.surface: A dog alerts a miner.
explanation.definitionFit: The Weimaraner is a grey German gundog breed.

clue.text: Valerie, in a mood, shows uncertainty

indicators.note: the short name sits inside the word for a mood

parts.note: an ambience is an atmosphere or mood
Val is short for Valerie

explanation.surface: Valerie, moody, shows she cannot decide.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambivalence is having mixed feelings, so a state of uncertainty.

clue.text: Shock for Tory in marsh

indicators.note: the political word goes inside the word for marsh

parts.note: a fen is low marshy land
the Tories are on the political right

explanation.surface: A Conservative gets a scare while stuck in a bog.
explanation.definitionFit: To frighten is to give someone a scare or a shock.

clue.text: Withdrawn book concealed by grass

indicators.note: the book word is hidden within the grass word

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass
a tract is a short book or pamphlet

explanation.surface: A book has been taken out of circulation after being hidden in tall grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Retracted means drawn back or withdrawn, as a claim or claws.

clue.text: Supporter's grand boast

parts.note: a bra is a supporting garment
G is short for a grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A fan shows off grandly.
explanation.definitionFit: To brag is to boast about oneself.

clue.text: Latest special model in media reports

definitions.note: plural phrase for a single broadcast made up of reports

parts.note: the latest is the newest
a cast is a model made from a mould

explanation.surface: The newest celebrity model features in the press.
explanation.definitionFit: A newscast is a broadcast bulletin carrying the news stories of the day.

clue.text: A section of obstetricians being retained after all

indicators.note: a section of the long word is just a run of its letters

explanation.surface: Some obstetricians are kept on after all.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'section' looks like a caesarean, but it only points to a letter run.
explanation.definitionFit: The proofreader's mark means let it stand, so the deleted text is kept after all.

clue.text: Old force keeps one week for inspection

indicators.note: the force word keeps the numeral one within it

parts.note: verve is vigour, force
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An old police force holds on to someone for a week while it looks into things.
explanation.definitionFit: An overview is a broad survey, a general inspection of something.

clue.text: Fiddle with FT's accuracy

parts.note: to rig is to fix or fiddle
the newspaper speaking of itself says our

explanation.surface: Someone tampers with the newspaper's precision.
explanation.definitionFit: Rigour means strict precision and exactness.

clue.text: Armies sell out in France

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of armies and sell are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: Troops are sold out in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Marseilles is the great port city on France's Mediterranean coast.

clue.text: Spike is a Latin expert

parts.note: an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: Spike is a Latin scholar.
explanation.definitionFit: To lace a drink, like spiking it, is to add alcohol secretly.

clue.text: Climber initially has a break below the summit

indicators.note: in a down entry the break word comes below the climber's letter
initially picks the opening letter of climber

parts.note: a rest is a break

explanation.surface: A mountaineer pauses just beneath the top.
explanation.definitionFit: A crest is the top of a hill or ridge, its summit.

clue.text: Catch the eye of porter grabbing joiner

indicators.note: the porter word grabs the joiner word inside it

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, like stout
and is a joining word, a conjunction

explanation.surface: A hotel porter grabs a carpenter.
explanation.walkthrough: Porter looks like a doorman and joiner like a carpenter; one is beer, the other a conjunction.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand out is to be conspicuous and catch people's attention.

clue.text: Crank barrel over

indicators.note: over signals the word for barrel is turned over, in reverse

parts.note: a tun is a large cask or barrel

explanation.surface: A crank turns a barrel over.
explanation.definitionFit: A nut is slang for an eccentric person, a crank.

clue.text: A stoppage of breath for years father rejected

indicators.note: rejected means the two words for years and father are thrown back in reverse

parts.note: an aeon is a vast stretch of years
pa is father

explanation.surface: Someone could not breathe for years after their father turned them away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns AEONPA round as a whole.
explanation.definitionFit: Apnoea is the medical term for a temporary halt in breathing.

clue.text: Newsman backing trend to gold

indicators.note: backing means the trend word is read backwards

parts.note: the tide of opinion is its trend
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A journalist backs a trend towards gold.
explanation.definitionFit: An editor runs a newspaper, so is a newsman.

clue.text: Competitor devours breakfast in suit

indicators.note: the competitor word devours the meal word, holding it inside

parts.note: an entry is a competitor in a contest
to breakfast is to eat

explanation.surface: A contestant wolfs down breakfast while in a suit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suit' looks like clothing; it means a plea.
explanation.definitionFit: A suit, in the sense of a petition, is an earnest request or entreaty.
